question: The famous autobiography 'Lessons life taught me unknowingly' is related to:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anupam Kher**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anupam Kher** is a renowned **Indian actor**.
 
• He has appeared in over **500 films** and many **plays**.
 
• The **autobiography** "Lessons Life Taught Me Unknowingly" is an **inspirational account of his life and career**.
 
• The book provides insights into his **struggles, achievements, and experiences** in the **Indian film industry**.
 
• Anupam Kher has won numerous **awards**, including the **Filmfare Award** for **Best Actor** in a **Comic Role**.
 
• He is also a recipient of the **Padma Shri** and **Padma Bhushan**, two of India's highest civilian honors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Jhulan Goswami**__

 __
 
• **Jhulan Goswami** is a former **Indian cricketer** known for her **fast bowling**.
 
• She has been one of the leading **wicket-takers** in **women's cricket**.
 
 
 
• **Sharad Pawar**__
 __
 
• **Sharad Pawar** is a prominent **Indian politician**.
 
• He is the founder of the **Nationalist Congress Party (NCP)**.
 
 
 
• **LK Advani**__
 
 
• **Lal Krishna Advani** is a veteran **Indian politician**.
 
• He served as the **Deputy Prime Minister of India** and is a senior leader of the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**.
